slices.focus: A family carpool to Lafayette reminds Ariana she needs short regional trips for restoration
slices.summary: Ariana rides with cousins to a church anniversary in Lafayette and realizes how much she misses short, low-stakes regional drives. She plans to be more intentional about grabbing nearby getaways with Devon when windows open up.
open_loops: Creating a short standing list of easy destinations (Lafayette, Baton Rouge, Gulf Coast)
Setting up a Thursday night check-in with Devon for weekend openings
Preparing a tiny go-bag list to reduce friction for spontaneous trips
decisions: Ariana's preference for short regional travel sharpened after a family carpool to Lafayette, making her more intentional
